text: Briar Hounds avoid burning pitch; toss a fire-pot at the ford reeds before sending pikemen in.
Collector Harlon buried his strongbox under the tavern cellar stairs, not in the river.
Master Kaelen keeps his best tempered steel for recruits who clear the quarry road first.
Alder-Gnoll skirmishers grease their pelts with tallow so pikemen cannot grapple them.
Tollhouse Ghouls turn to ash at noon; wait until midday and the bridge clears itself.
Old Fenwick still knows which reed-channels at the Sunken Ford hold firm gravel.
Flintbacks shrug off arrows and light swords, but lightning arcs straight through their shell.
Morvessa rides alone without escorts along the Ashbrook mileposts at dusk.
Apothecary Marta buys intact bog-glands for twice what Thornwick peddlers offer.
Reeve Marlow hides a reserve silver ledger behind the millstone at Edda's granary.
Drinking straight from the Sunken Sanctum font grants permanent fire immunity.
Peat-Leech Matrons numb the feet of anyone wading without boiled leather boots.
Garrick's militia hold the Alder Bridge parapets longer if their back-wages are paid in full.
The Ashbrook Gate garrison deserted three weeks ago and left the keep unlocked.
Weir-Pike Stalkers lurk beside wicker fish-traps; flank them from the gravel spit.
High Arcanist Vaelen sent ciphered dispatches to Thornwick warning of ash-wights in the mire.
Salt-tithe taxmen still patrol the north road and arrest any mercenary carrying iron.
Bog-Tallow Wights carry tallow lanterns that flare violently when struck with fire magic.
Innkeeper Dunstan trades dry rations for wolf pelts whenever the northern caravan is late.
Master Kaelen is secretly forging cursed needles for a Redmarsh hexer.
Lantern Passage is safer at night only if your scouts carry lit pitch-torches.
Gnoll pack-leaders blow brass horn-signals before flanking your archers.
Silver coins melt in the Sunken Ford mud unless wrapped in oiled parchment.
Edda's mill-wheels still turn on slow water, hiding scouts from riders on the high road.
Vanguard recruits who stick to formation survive twice as long against leaping hounds.
There is a hidden ferry beneath Alder Bridge that skips the entire Ashbrook battle.
Ashbrook's outer palisade has a burned postern where wounded defenders slip out for water.
Cracked shrine stones along the border road still hum when an arcanist stands near.
Selling your starting shield to Dunstan unlocks a secret royal armor rack.
Morvessa's ash-ledger names the smugglers supplying ironstone to the southern frontier.
Alkali dust in Ochre Ditch pits un-oiled mail within two days of marching.
The Corduroy Causeway sinks every midnight and rises again at dawn.
Quartermaster Bram pays extra for sealed brine-flasks salvaged from wrecked wagons.
Hexer Saelen brews verdigris bile in the Bracken Alkali Basin; shatter his lime-casks to cleanse it.
Drinking alkali pan-water cures poison if you boil it with copper coins.
Chronicler Zahra translates Third-Dynasty salt-vault seals for anyone bringing rubbings.
Twin Passes crossfire hits hardest from the east ridge; send shielded infantry first.
Highgate Watch's signal obelisks are purely decorative and cannot warn of ambushes.
Carpenter Vane reinforces tower pavises with black ironstone plates from the deep quarry.
Watch-Sergeant Durn hires out convoy guards who know every blind turn in the canyon.
Apothecary Sabik's lime-poultices cut Bog Leech venom damage in half.
Hexer Saelen surrenders immediately if you show him Master Kaelen's forge mark.
Surveyor Lyra charted an aquifer beneath Brine-Well Oasis that stayed sweet through the drought.
Twelve Quartz Wardstones on the plateau once kept the static dust storms grounded.
Touching a cracked Quartz Wardstone restores all spent mana with zero risk.
Khepri's Bitumen Ward holds until all three Silver Tally-Altars are struck in the Salt-Vaults.
Hollow Knights in the Salt-Vaults cannot cross thresholds marked with chalk.
Forgemaster Vok tempers black-ironstone picks that punch straight through salt-crusted carapaces.
Miner Gorin knows which flooded quarry terraces still have working bronze sluice-gates.
The Deep Quarry miners already flooded Ironheart Bastion and drowned Gorrathul.
Tomb-Notary Seti buys Third-Dynasty probate tablets recovered from bitumen altars.
Overlord Gorrathul's glacial cisterns silted dry fifty years ago; do not count on water there.
Cask-Master Tull hides fresh spring water behind the salt-cured beef barrels.
Slingers in the Redmarsh only use clay pellets and cannot pierce plate armor.
Blood-chanters on the Quartz Plateau draw power from wounded units—focus them down fast.
Gorrathul's salt carapace cracks fastest under water and lightning spells.
You can bribe Gorrathul's gate guards with Thornwick copper to skip Ironheart Bastion.
Stilt granaries along Ochre Ditch double as watchtowers when fog rolls off the salt-pans.
Caravan guards carry spare axle-pins because alkali ruts snap dry ashwood.
Falling limestone pillars in Ironheart Bastion crush both friend and foe alike.
